_doc: Copy to config/realtor.json, or let Phase 0 onboarding write it for you. This file is the single source of truth for everything realtor-specific. No realtor details are hardcoded anywhere in scripts or templates.

branding._doc: Neutral placeholders. Replace with the realtor's real palette. Every colour and font in the graphic and email templates comes from here -- none are hardcoded. All suggested fonts are SIL Open Font Licence, free for commercial use. Set google_fonts to false to fall back to system fonts and skip the webfont fetch entirely.

drive._doc: Google Drive folder that listing photo subfolders live under. Used to stage rendered graphics.
